g.text: Engineering prototype – not production qualified. Scale 1:1. F.Cu coordinate view; underside NOT mirrored.
Cu-ETP / CW004A; thickness 2.00 +/-0.10 mm; outline +/-0.20 mm; hole centers +/-0.10 mm.
Holes diameter 3.40 +/-0.10 mm. Cutout radius R1. Deburr. Exact vertices/holes: BUSBAR_DIMENSIONS.json.
4 x 0.05 mm Kapton HN underneath; 0.25 mm Cu contact shims. No shunt or FET-bank bypass.
